entry.name: Rillaboom-H
entry.flavor: Though it has a calm disposition, it won't tolerate those who drum up discord. It strictly disciplines offenders until they learn their lesson.
entry.flavorEs: El percusionista con la técnica más depurada se convierte en líder. Son de carácter tranquilo y dan mucha importancia a la armonía del grupo.
entry.flavorZh: 打鼓技巧最高超的那一只 会成为首领。性情温和， 重视族群的和谐相处。

abilities.textEn: At 1/3 or less of its max HP, this Pokemon's offensive stat is 1.5x with Grass attacks.
abilities.textEs: Potencia sus movimientos de tipo Planta cuando le quedan pocos PS.
abilities.detail: When this Pokemon has 1/3 or less of its maximum HP, rounded down, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Grass-type attack.
abilities.detailEs: Cuando a este Pokémon le queda 1/3 o menos de sus PS, sus movimientos de tipo Planta infligen 1.5× de daño normal.
abilities.detailZh: 当该宝可梦剩余HP为1/3或以下时，其草属性招式造成1.5×的常规伤害。
abilities.detailPt: Quando este Pokémon tem 1/3 ou menos do seu HP restante, seus movimentos do tipo Planta infligem 1.5× o dano normal.

abilities.textEn: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Grassy Terrain.
abilities.textEs: Crea un campo de hierba al entrar en combate.
abilities.detail: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Grassy Terrain.
abilities.detailEs: Cuando este Pokémon entra en combate, cambia el terreno a Campo de Hierba.
abilities.detailZh: 当此宝可梦出场时，将场地变为青草场地。
abilities.detailPt: Quando este Pokémon entra em batalha, ele muda o terreno para Grassy Terrain.
